    "title": "storage: Add explicit migration skeleton and cleanup tests",
    "description": "# Black Hat Repaired Bead Spec

Source docs:
- to-fix/09-restate-architecture-steal-plan.md
- to-fix/10-restate-exhaustive-sweep.md

No-copy fence:
- Restate is failure-mode inspiration only; do not copy code, APIs, data model, module structure, async architecture, HTTP/JSON paths, storage layout, wire formats, or distributed assumptions.
- Master contract overrides this bead. Runtime/core work stays single-server, shard-owned, numeric, bounded, and free of JSON/YAML/HTTP interpretation. CLI/doctor diagnostics are cold-path only.

Test file:
- crates/workspace_tests/tests/restate_explicit_migration_skeleton_tests.rs

Command evidence:
- cargo nextest run -p velvet-ballastics-workspace-tests --test restate_explicit_migration_skeleton_tests
- moon ci

Scope:
Add a named migration test skeleton that seeds an old storage shape, runs an explicit CLI/tool migration, and verifies old keyspace cleanup and manifest version update.

Target public surface / files to read:
- /tmp/opencode/restate/crates/partition-store/src/migrations.rs
- crates/vb_storage/src
- velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md

Acceptance tests:
Happy paths:
- Explicit migration moves old record shape into new keyspace and updates manifest
- Reopening after migration reads new records without invoking migration

Error paths:
- invalid input old schema at runtime open returns MigrationRequired
- missing migration verification prevents manifest update

Edge cases:
- empty old keyspace migration leaves manifest unchanged or records no-op outcome
- partial old keyspace cleanup failure returns typed migration error

Contract assertions:
- Old keyspace is empty after migration when cleanup is required
- Every supported old version names a migration function

Preconditions:
- Storage manifest version code has been read
- A minimal old-version fixture is defined in tests only

Postconditions:
- Runtime open rejects old version with typed migration-required error
- Explicit migration test verifies old keys empty and new keys exact

Invariants:
- Migrations are named
- Manifest advances after verification
- Runtime startup does not mutate old schema

Implementation gates:
- Write failing tests in the named workspace_tests file before production changes.
- Implement only the minimal VB change required by those tests.
- Close only with raw output from the scoped cargo nextest command and moon ci.
